verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੇ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ਰੂਪ ਧਰਿ ਸੂਰਜ ਬੰਸੀ ਵਡਿ ਅਵਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: trete chhatree roop dhar sooraj ba(n)see vadd avataaraa|

en.bdb: In Treta in the Sun-dynasty descended in the form of the kshatriya(Ram) a great incarnation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਹਿਸੇ ਗਈ ਆਰਜਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: nau hise giee aarajaa maiaa moh aha(n)kaar pasaaraa|

en.bdb: Now the nine portions of age lessened and illusion,attachment and ego inflated.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਜਾਦਵ ਵੰਸ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਅਉਧ ਘਟੈ ਆਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhuaapur jaadhav va(n)s kar jug jug aaudh ghaTai aachaaraa|

en.bdb: In Dvapar, Yadav-dynasty came to the forefront i.e. the incarnation of Krishna became known to the people; but because of the lack of good conduct, Age by Age, the life span (of man) went on decreasing.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਗ ਬੇਦ ਮਹਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੂਰਬ ਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: rig bedh meh braham kirat poorab mukh subh karam bichaaraa|

en.bdb: In the Rgveda the conduct of the brahmin and the ideas about the actions done facing the East were discussed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਥਾਪੇ ਜੁਜਰੁ ਵੇਦਿ ਦਖਣ ਮੁਖਿ ਬਹੁ ਦਾਨ ਦਾਤਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: khatree thaape jujar vedh dhakhan mukh bahu dhaan dhaataaraa|

en.bdb: Kshatriyas became related to the Yajurveda and started pouring charities while facing the South.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੈਸੋਂ ਥਾਪਿਆ ਸਿਆਮ ਵੇਦੁ ਪਛਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਸੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaiso(n) thaapiaa siaam vedh pachham mukh kar sees nivaaraa|

en.bdb: The vaishyas embraced the Samaveda and bowed to the West.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਿਗਿ ਨੀਲੰਬਰਿ ਜੁਜਰ ਪੀਤ ਸ੍ਵੇਤੰਬਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਆਮ ਸੁਧਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: rig neela(n)bar jujar peet savaieta(n)bar kar siaam sudhaaraa|

en.bdb: Blue dress for Rgveda, yellow for Yajurveda and for singing of the hymns of Samaveda wearing of the white dress became a tradition.
Thus three duties of the three Ages were enunciated.
